details:
tl;dr is pretty much that sometimes the regular menu will somehow be invisible and infront of the keyboard, even tho you never opened the menu anywhere.

This leads to accidentally recalibrating your avatar or opening other menu items that you never saw. You can also notice how its infront of it when clicking the buttons doesnt create a sound, or a letter. It doesnt always open menus, but its very annoying when you have to move either the keyboard, yourself or playspace around in order to use it again.

This has been going on for months, I just dont play enough to report it, but its still here now.

1. Use Keyboard

2. Keyboard wont make sounds or produce letters on click anymore, instead youll suddenly open your avatar list, settings, or if the vrchat devs blessed you, will have to recalibrate again.

3. Sometimes moving the keyboard around will move it away from the main menu, but only sometimes. Some buttons might work, but most will be overriden by the main menu buttons that you cant see.

Just to make sure, I do mean on VR.

as for version number.. its been there for months idk.
title: Keyboard bugged when typing, main menu infront invisible
